Using the previously unused conditions:

\[
0.3N = 0.4 \times 112 = 44.8 \quad\Rightarrow\quad N = \frac{44.8}{0.3} = \frac{448}{3}
\]

\[
0.7N = 0.25F \quad\Rightarrow\quad F = \frac{0.7}{0.25}N = 2.8N
\]

Thus,

\[
F = 2.8 \times \frac{448}{3} = \frac{14}{5} \times \frac{448}{3} = \frac{6272}{15}
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{6272}{15}}
\]
